row.evidence: SAP's HCM pricing page lists only the SAP HCM Base and Premium packages at "Price upon request", and SAP Help documents the SuccessFactors Workforce SCIM API as "System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) 2.0 REST APIs" for users and groups.
row.notes: Quote-only: SAP HCM (SuccessFactors) Base and Premium packages are both 'Price upon request' (blocks of 1 user, 1-5 year contracts). The SCIM plan is recorded as the Base package because SCIM is a platform API and no package gate is published. The Workforce SCIM API (https://<api-server>/rest/iam/scim/v2/Users and /Groups) supports create, replace, modify, search and delete users and static permission-group membership, but SAP says creating users through SCIM isn't recommended and SuccessFactors mainly acts as a source of identities; data purge is preferred over SCIM delete. SCIM needs case-insensitive usernames, which only supports SAML SSO. Okta's OIN app is mainly an HR source (Attribute Sourcing/Writeback, Create/Update, no Deactivate); Entra offers SSO, inbound HR provisioning and an attribute writeback app. Outbound: SuccessFactors feeds IdPs as an HR master. Users can also be managed via the OData v2 User entity and file imports.

scim.notes: sso_required: SCIM needs Enable Case-Insensitive Usernames, which only supports SAML SSO. Plan is not published (quote-only).

deprovision.data_retained: SAP recommends the data purge tool rather than SCIM delete; the SCIM active attribute maps to the account status.

filtering.notes: /Users/.search is documented; filter attributes are not listed.

custom.how: SAP extensions: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:sap:2.0:User (groupDomains, userUuid), urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:successfactors:2.0:User (perPersonUuid, loginMethod, personIdExternal, customFields custom01-custom15) and sap.workforce (lastDeactivated, empId).

attributes.notes: Many attributes (names, title, department, division, manager, custom fields) are read-only through SCIM.

roles.how: Membership of static permission groups through the SCIM Groups PATCH API; dynamic groups are attribute-driven.

limitations.text: Creating user accounts through SCIM isn't recommended; SuccessFactors works mainly as a source system for workforce identities.
Creating or deleting groups via the Groups API isn't supported; only static permission-group membership can be changed (up to 1000 accounts per batch).
Customers don't have access to Provisioning; enabling some settings needs the implementation partner or Account Executive.

user_api.notes: OData v2 User entity; SFAPI is deprecated.

okta.notes: OIN page (Directory and HR Sync) marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Attribute Sourcing, Schema Discovery and Attribute Writeback as checked; Deactivate and Group Push not checked (read from page markup). Mainly an HR-source integration.

entra.notes: Gallery SSO app plus inbound HR provisioning from SuccessFactors; outbound to SuccessFactors is the Writeback app, which only writes attributes such as work email, username and phone numbers to Employee Central.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound: SuccessFactors is an HR source for IdPs (Okta, Entra inbound provisioning) and SAP Cloud Identity Services Identity Provisioning, which can also target SuccessFactors through the SCIM connector.
